description: This file defines the FriendsScreen UI for a Flutter mobile app, which manages and displays a user's list of friends, supports searching for new users, and allows adding or removing friends. It interacts with a social repository for data operations.

classes.name: FriendsScreen
classes.description: Main widget displaying the list of friends, search functionality, and user interactions.

classes.name: _FriendTile
classes.description: A widget representing a single friend item with remove functionality.

classes.name: _SearchResultTile
classes.description: A widget for displaying search results with add functionality.

methods.name: _loadFriends
methods.description: Fetches the list of friends from the repository.

methods.name: _search
methods.description: Performs a search for users based on the input text.

methods.name: _add
methods.description: Adds a user as a friend via the repository.

methods.name: _remove
methods.description: Removes a friend by userId via the repository.
